inputs.description: Independent pitch analysis of the three coo recordings: F0 and loudest-partial tracks per note, spread, and how thin the evidence is
Blue rock pigeon song recorded May 2012 at Sangli, India; pulsed coos, 100 Hz hum
Feral rock pigeon 'Pedro' cooing, Paris, hand-held Olympus LS-12 under 50 cm (xeno-canto XC539061 via Wikimedia Commons)
The same Paris feral pigeon on another day, about 30 cm, vacuum cleaner in the background (xeno-canto XC541143 via Wikimedia Commons)
Research notes with sources: support-free one-piece FDM whistles, print orientation study, windway and labium numbers, toy safety limits
Research notes with sources: Helmholtz vessel-flute model, end corrections, published validation instruments, voicing rules, error band

meta.name: pigeon-whistle
meta.summary: A 3D-printable whistle shaped like a pigeon that sounds at a pigeon call frequency

params.name: body_center_x_mm
params.rationale: Body ellipsoid centre. Leaves x 30-41 for the window and labium ramp behind the body, and the breast ends near x = 117 so the whole bird stays inside 118 mm.

params.name: body_center_z_mm
params.rationale: Body centre height: the belly then meets the bed at 40 deg from vertical with no skirt band.

params.name: body_radius_x_mm
params.rationale: Body half-length. With the other two radii, and the rump lobe, it sets the chamber at 118.8 cm^3.

rejected.why: 92.4 cm^3 chamber: the quietest and breathiest of the three concepts (radiated share of losses 4.7 %)
cost a 117 x 67 mm body, an 8.2 mm finger hole and a 21 h print

params.name: body_radius_y_mm
params.rationale: Body half-width: 66.8 mm, plus 0.6 mm wing bars, inside the 68 mm width limit.

params.name: body_radius_z_mm
params.rationale: Body half-height: back at z = 59, which leaves the head 8.7 mm proud of it.

params.name: chest_lead_mm
params.rationale: Chest ellipsoid centre ahead of the body centre: the breast leads the head (a pigeon's does).

params.name: head_center_x_mm
params.rationale: Head tucked onto the chest; with the beak it ends at x = 115.0, behind the crop (116.7).

params.name: head_center_z_mm
params.rationale: Head top at 67.7 mm, inside the 68 mm height limit.

params.name: head_radius_mm
params.rationale: Small solid head: head diameter / body width = 0.40, the ratio the character judge read as pigeon.

rejected.why: head / body width 0.44 read as a chick or sparrow

params.name: beak_length_mm
params.rationale: Slim straight bill, about a quarter of the head's diameter.

params.name: beak_pitch_deg
params.rationale: Bill points this far below horizontal, its tip resting 1.2 mm deep in the crop.

rejected.why: read as a parrot hook, and the tip started in mid-air for 2.55 mm (21 layers)

params.name: beak_base_radius_mm
params.rationale: Bill radius at the face.

params.name: beak_tip_radius_mm
params.rationale: Blunt tip: no thorn at face height, and three 0.45 mm lines wide so it prints as a solid.

params.name: eye_radius_mm
params.rationale: Eye dimple radius at the head surface: nine lines across, it survives the nozzle.

params.name: eye_depth_mm
params.rationale: Eye dimple depth: a cone this shallow has every face steeper than 45 deg.

rejected.why: looked frog-like

params.name: eye_azimuth_deg
params.rationale: Eyes set to the side, as on a pigeon (0 would look forward).

params.name: eye_elevation_deg
params.rationale: Eyes above the head's equator.

params.name: wing_center_z_mm
params.rationale: Wing centre height: low on the flank so the front view has no raised shoulders.

rejected.why: wings stood proud of the chest as raised shoulders: a penguin from the front

params.name: wing_pitch_deg
params.rationale: Wing pitch: tips slightly up toward the rump.

params.name: wing_bar_width_mm
params.rationale: Two wing bars per wing: the one pigeon marking that works in a single filament colour.

params.name: wing_bar_proud_mm
params.rationale: Bar relief: five 0.12 mm layers, readable but not a ledge.

params.name: wing_bar_length_mm
params.rationale: Bar length across the upper flank.

params.name: foot_length_mm
params.rationale: Two low oval foot pads under the chest.

rejected.why: showed as a fringe under the chest in the top view

params.name: foot_width_mm
params.rationale: Foot pad width.

params.name: foot_height_mm
params.rationale: Foot pad height.

params.name: tail_half_width_mm
params.rationale: Half-width of the tail root and rump: 28 mm, so the window flank is a flat vertical wall with room for the lobe (lobe_width_mm) behind it.

params.name: tail_tip_half_width_mm
params.rationale: Half-width at the tail tip: a 24.6 x 14 mm mouthpiece that leaves >= 1.5 mm of rim beside the inlet.

params.name: tail_top_z_mm
params.rationale: Tail top: 4.7 mm over the windway, 3.5 mm of roof rim left at the inlet after the edge radius.

rejected.value: 11.8 mm with a 3 mm edge radius
rejected.why: inlet rim 0.2 mm at x = 0.2 mm: a feather edge where teeth and lips land

params.name: lip_stop_x_mm
params.rationale: A full-width rise in the tail top stops the lips here, 15 mm short of the window.

rejected.value: a stop on the centre line only
rejected.why: at y = +-9 mm the tail top stayed under 14 mm until x = 22 mm: lips slid on to the window flank

params.name: lip_stop_rise_mm
params.rationale: Height of the lip stop.

params.name: self_support_deg
params.rationale: Bottom-up trim of the skin: nothing leans out more than this from vertical (limit 45).

rejected.why: left 261 mm^2 of skin in the 43-45 deg bin: fdm.overhang failed at 0.71-0.82 % at every resolution
hung a cone under the beak tip that did not reach the chest: an island

params.name: shell_wall_mm
params.rationale: Shell wall: five 0.45 mm perimeters, airtight.

params.name: floor_mm
params.rationale: Chamber floor above the bed (17 layers): the thinnest section of the shell.

params.name: roof_angle_deg
params.rationale: Every chamber roof plane leans this far from vertical: 3 deg inside the 45 deg limit.

rejected.why: failed fdm.overhang at every resolution tried (no margin against a strict > 45 deg test)
4384 mm^2 of roof within 2 deg of the limit

rejected.value: a flat cap under the ridge
rejected.why: flat strips are bridges inside the chamber: 10-12 mm spans measured

params.name: lobe_ridge_z_mm
params.rationale: Ridge of the rump lobe. Its eave on the window wall then sits 0.76 mm ABOVE the lintel, so the roof lands on a wall, and the rump crest above it is 25.65 mm.

rejected.value: 25.5 mm (the first build, over an 8 mm high window)
rejected.why: once the window was lowered to 6.3 mm the eave stood 3.0 mm above the lintel for nothing: a rump crest of 27.9 mm against the 22-27 mm asked for
the lobe roof's eave comes out below the lintel: a hanging edge along the top of the window (measured on the first build: 1.1 mm below at 23.2 mm under the taller window)

params.name: lobe_width_mm
params.rationale: Width of the rump lobe, from the window's inner plane to its far wall (the rest of the rump, on the bird's right, is solid). The lobe section beside the jet is then 253 mm^2 = 5.7 x the window: the narrowest the design allows (>= 250 mm^2 and >= 4.5 x), taken because the window's own conductance was 16 % too high for 340 Hz and a throat lowers it without narrowing the jet.

rejected.value: 22 mm, the whole rump (385 mm^2 beside the jet)
rejected.why: window conductance 4.93 mm on the 121 cm^3 chamber: the note solved at 352 Hz with the vent PLUGGED, above the 340 Hz target before any vent is opened
lowered the window conductance 10 %, but is under the 250 mm^2 / 4.5 x floor set for the lobe: a throat again

params.name: windway_length_mm
params.rationale: Windway from the tail tip to its exit at x = 30.

rejected.why: twice the length in which a string or seam can sit, about 30 Pa more pressure drop
put the window 7.4 mm from the lip stop

params.name: windway_height_mm
params.rationale: Slot height (Z) = jet width = window height. Solved: with the 7.0 mm cut-up it makes the 44 mm^2 window whose conductance (4.08 mm) leaves the vent-plugged note 90 cents under 340 Hz.

rejected.why: with a 263 mm^2 lobe and a 4 mm wall the vent-plugged note still solved about 25 cents ABOVE 340 Hz (h = 0.4 mm, extrapolated); it has to be 60-140 cents below for the vent to trim both ways
vent-plugged note about 41 cents under 340 Hz (h = 0.4 mm, extrapolated): short of the 60 cents wanted

params.name: windway_floor_z_mm
params.rationale: Windway floor above the bed, clear of elephant foot; the window sill is at the same height, 0.9 mm above the chamber floor, so the bird drains tail-down.

params.name: windway_gap_inlet_mm
params.rationale: Slot gap at the lips: 2:1 convergence to the exit.

params.name: windway_gap_exit_mm
params.rationale: Slot gap at the exit (the jet thickness).

params.name: windway_skew_deg
params.rationale: The slot is turned this far outward in plan: the inlet sits 2.9 mm inside the tail tip while the exit reaches the flank. Windway, window and labium turn together, so the jet still meets the edge.

params.name: windway_exit_chamfer_mm
params.rationale: 45 deg chamfers on both exit lips (recorder and organ practice: 0.5-0.7 mm).

params.name: cutup_mm
params.rationale: Cut-up: windway exit to labium edge.

params.name: window_wall_mm
params.rationale: Wall depth at the window, mid cut-up (the deep end of the 3-4 mm allowed). The window opens straight from the flank into the lobe.

rejected.why: 2 mm more wall lowered the window conductance only 5 % (the passage flares on the ramp and lintel sides); 16 % was needed

rejected.value: a window opening into a throat (L_eff 15.8-17 mm)
rejected.why: independent solve read 317 Hz and 331 Hz against the designers' 340 Hz: the throat junction was not in their models
under the gripping thumb: -64 cents with a pad resting over it

params.name: lintel_flat_mm
params.rationale: Flat bridge over the window at the labium; with the ramp receding the outermost of its three strands is 4.2 mm. The rest of the window top is 43 deg haunches.

rejected.value: a 7-12.6 mm flat bridge over the jet
rejected.why: the largest flat ceiling of the three concepts, directly at the jet top
with the ramp receding at 25 deg the outermost strand of a 1.5 mm deep strip would be 5.0 mm

params.name: labium_tip_mm
params.rationale: Flat on the labium tip: one line wide. A knife edge is truncated by the slicer anyway and that lengthens the cut-up by an unknown amount.

params.name: labium_ramp_deg
params.rationale: Ramp on the outer face of the labium.

params.name: labium_offset_mm
params.rationale: Labium tip centre outside the windway mid-plane (0 to +0.1 mm).

params.name: hole_d_mm
params.rationale: Finger hole diameter. Solved: the open note is 470 Hz in the potential-flow solve (the hole adds 4.11 mm of conductance). Must stay <= 7.5 mm to seal under a child's fingertip.

rejected.why: what a 145 cm^3 chamber needed: marginal for a child's fingertip (7-8 mm limit)

params.name: hole_x_mm
params.rationale: Finger hole on the centre line of the back, a vertical bore through the roof ridge: either hand.

params.name: hole_chimney_mm
params.rationale: Cylindrical length of the finger hole below the dimple floor; below it the bore opens downward at roof_angle_deg (an undercut tone hole, printable like the roof). A plain bore through the 42 deg gable is 2.05 mm long on the ridge line and 5.5 mm at the sides.

rejected.value: a plain bore through the gable (no undercut)
rejected.why: 8 % less conductance at the same diameter (solved at 6.6 and 7.0 mm): 470 Hz would need an estimated 7.5-7.6 mm, at or over the 7.5 mm a child's fingertip seals
2.5 % less hole conductance than 2.5 mm for no gain: the roof is 2.05 mm on the ridge line either way

params.name: dimple_radius_mm
params.rationale: Finger dimple sphere radius.

params.name: dimple_depth_mm
params.rationale: Finger dimple depth: found by feel, 9 mm across.

rejected.why: left 1.73 mm of roof on the uphill side of the hole (measured on the 0.35 mm mesh)

params.name: vent_d_mm
params.rationale: Tuning vent diameter, printed OPEN. Solved: with the vent open the closed note is 340 Hz (vent conductance 0.446 mm). Plug it to lower the closed note 90 cents, ream it to raise it.

rejected.why: closed note 340.8 Hz in the solve (+0.23 %); 2.1 mm centres it (340.1 Hz)

rejected.value: a blind pilot to drill out
rejected.why: one-sided trim: no clean way down if the print lands sharp
likely to print shut

params.name: vent_x_mm
params.rationale: Vent on the rump crown, a vertical bore through the lobe ridge: behind the gripping fingers and 20 mm in front of the lips, with a 2.8 mm chimney.

rejected.why: the body's back rises there: chimney 3.99 mm at x = 39, against the 3 mm limit

params.name: hole_comp_mm
params.rationale: Added to both bore diameters in the mesh: FDM holes print 0.1-0.3 mm small.

params.name: windway_gap_comp_mm
params.rationale: Added to the windway gap in the mesh (1.4 drawn for 1.3): slots close up the same way.

params.name: nozzle_d_mm
params.rationale: The person's nozzle (requirement R3).

params.name: extrusion_width_mm
params.rationale: Line width: 5 perimeters = 2.25 mm = the shell wall.

params.name: layer_height_mm
params.rationale: Fine layers for a smooth airway (R3: "high quality"); 0.16 is allowed.

rejected.why: coarser steps on the windway and labium; 0.16 is the stated fallback

params.name: perimeters
params.rationale: Walls: the whole 2.2 mm shell is perimeters, no infill seam to leak.

params.name: infill_fraction
params.rationale: Sparse infill in the thick roof wedges, head and tail block (15-20 %).

rejected.why: 107 g and a 21 h print for the same shell

params.name: print_speed_mm_s
params.rationale: Average speed assumed by the pack's time estimate (+-30 %).

params.name: filament_density_g_cm3
params.rationale: PLA first.

rejected.why: strings across the windway

params.name: bed_x_mm
params.rationale: ASSUMPTION: the person's printer is not recorded; 180 x 180 x 180 mm is the smallest common bed.

params.name: bed_y_mm
params.rationale: ASSUMPTION, as bed_x_mm.

params.name: bed_z_mm
params.rationale: ASSUMPTION, as bed_x_mm.

params.name: brim_mm
params.rationale: Allowance round the footprint for a brim or skirt.

params.name: overhang_limit_deg
params.rationale: Overhang limit the mesh is judged against (the fdm-print pack's conservative default).

params.name: max_bridge_mm
params.rationale: Longest flat bridge allowed: the design has two, the windway roof (2.8 mm) and the lintel (4.2 mm).

params.name: max_length_mm
params.rationale: Palm size (R4: about 10-12 cm).

params.name: max_width_mm
params.rationale: Palm size: a hand closes round it.

params.name: max_height_mm
params.rationale: Palm size.

params.name: c_air_m_s
params.rationale: Speed of sound in the played instrument: about 25 C, breath-warmed air.

params.name: target_closed_hz
params.rationale: Design centre, hole closed: the loudest part of the coo (R2).

rejected.why: an independent re-measurement of the coo's low note; the person chose 340 -> 470, and a print that lands sharp is still inside the measured band

params.name: target_open_hz
params.rationale: Design centre, hole open: the top of the coo's rise (R2).

params.name: k_window
params.rationale: End-correction factor of the window in G = A / (t + k r_eq), with A = cut-up x window height and t = window_depth_mm. CALIBRATED against the potential-flow solve of THIS geometry (model/solve.py GRID_STUDY: cut-cell grids 0.25-0.8 mm, least squares to h = 0): window conductance 4.084 mm. Textbook range for a voiced window 1.5-2.3; no source gives one number.

params.name: k_hole
params.rationale: End-correction factor of the finger hole (t = hole_depth_mm). CALIBRATED against the same solve on the same grids: the open hole adds 4.109 mm (4.106 with the vent plugged, 4.112 with it open). Textbook range for a bore through a flat wall 1.46-1.70; higher here because the bore's inner end sits in the 84 deg gable under the roof ridge.

params.name: k_vent
params.rationale: End-correction factor of the tuning vent (t = vent_depth_mm). CALIBRATED against the same solve on the same grids: the open vent adds 0.446 mm. Textbook range 1.46-1.70; far above it because the vent enters the lobe at the apex of its 84 deg roof wedge, which is narrower than the bore itself for the first 1.2 mm below the ridge.

params.name: vent_ream_max_mm
params.rationale: Largest diameter the vent is reamed to when tuning the closed note up (a 3.5 mm drill): the upward reach. It is the largest size that was solved (2.5 / 3.0 / 3.5 mm raise the closed note 24 / 56 / 89 cents); nothing larger has been looked at.

params.name: blow_pressure_pa
params.rationale: Nominal blowing pressure for the jet numbers: the common point at which both notes speak (inputs/references/vessel-flute-acoustics-notes.md section 2.2: 150-250 Pa; each note alone speaks from about 100 to 650 Pa). Not measured on a player.

requirements.statement: It looks like a pigeon: a chubby, cute city pigeon
It sounds like a pigeon: the same frequency as a city/feral pigeon's coo, matched to the loudest part of the coo, about 340 Hz rising to about 470 Hz
It can be 3D printed on my FDM printer with a 0.4 mm nozzle in PLA or PETG; I can print high quality for smoother air chambers
One finger hole for the 'roo': rocking a finger over it gives the rolling coo-roo-coo
It is a toy, gift or desk piece: fun to blow and recognisably pigeon-ish; it does not have to fool a bird

process model applies — extent 118 mm reads as millimetres; volume fills 0.17 of the bbox; layer/nozzle 0.30 inside 0.1-0.75; width/nozzle 1.12 inside 0.8-2.0; thinnest section 5.2 beads wide

asserted.hint: accepted provisionally, with a reason and an owner — an assumption, or a claim carried outside an evaluator's operating context — unresolved

blocked.hint: an evaluator skipped — its tool is missing here, it skipped itself on its input, or a prerequisite is not established — and none failed: no usable verdict

errored.hint: an evaluator errored: it crashed, so nothing was evaluated, and the evaluator itself is broken

fail.hint: an evaluator failed the current design, a physical result failed, or an evaluator's value does not meet the claim's acceptance condition

pass.hint: every evaluator is qualified and passed on the current inputs, inside its operating context, and every value compared with the acceptance condition meets it — checked does not mean true

pending.hint: an evaluator of the claim is unrun on the current inputs

refuted.hint: an evaluator failed the current design, a physical result failed, or an evaluator's value does not meet the claim's acceptance condition

stale.hint: a pass whose read set has changed since, or whose prerequisite is invalidated or unrun: nothing is checked now

unclaimed.hint: no evaluator, none qualified, one unqualified, or one outside its operating context; or an assumption nobody owns

unverified.hint: waits on an article: no physical result yet, or a pass no article binds to the current inputs

verified.hint: every evaluator is qualified and passed on the current inputs, inside its operating context, and every value compared with the acceptance condition meets it — checked does not mean true
